items.h: 119th Congress brings firsts for women of color
items.m: In the Senate, two Black women are serving concurrently for the first time. And in the House, two states and one U.S. territory elected their first Black, Hispanic or Pacific Islander woman lawmaker.

items.h: 119th Congress brings new growth in racial, ethnic diversity to Capitol Hill
items.m: Overall, 139 of today’s senators and representatives identify as Black, Hispanic, Asian American or Native American.
